key_insight: Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO) fixes long-horizon LLM RL instability by correcting the trajectory-level state distribution shift that standard token- or sequence-level methods miss.
engineering_relevance: For training reasoning LLMs on long rollouts, TAPO offers a more stable optimization path that can improve performance without collapsing as trajectories get longer.
method: Derives a state-distribution correction from the off-policy policy gradient and adds it to the RL objective.
Uses a geometric-mean estimator to reduce variance across long trajectories.
Applies length-aware dynamic clipping to prevent overly large updates along the rollout.
evidence_signal: Across eight competition-level benchmarks, TAPO reports up to 48% improvement over GRPO on mathematical reasoning and 12% on algorithmic coding, with stronger training stability.
watch_item: The trajectory-correction and dynamic clipping may add implementation complexity and require careful tuning for very long or noisy rollouts.
paper_title: Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization: Closing the State Distribution Gap in Long-Horizon LLM RL
